questions.question: Development in Geography is best defined as:
options: A rise in the number of factories
A process in which people's quality of life improves

questions.question: Quality of life includes:
options: Health, education, safety, housing and freedom as well as income
Only the number of cars owned
Only the size of a city

questions.question: Standard of living refers mainly to:
options: Material wealth and the goods and services people can afford

questions.question: Why must development be measured over time?
options: Because development is a process that can move forwards or backwards
Because statistics are collected only once

subtopics.title: Economic, Social and Environmental Aspects of Development

questions.question: GDP measures:
options: The number of people in a country
The total value of goods and services produced in a year

questions.question: Which is an example of social development?
Environmental development is concerned with:
options: Building as many factories as possible
Using resources so that they last for the future

questions.question: Which statement best shows how the aspects of development interact?
options: They have nothing to do with each other
Better education raises workers' skills, which supports economic growth
Economic growth always harms social development

subtopics.title: Classifying Countries: Developed, Developing, North and South

questions.question: The Brandt Line divided the world into:
options: A richer North and a poorer South
The northern and southern hemispheres exactly

questions.question: Why was Australia placed in the "North" on the Brandt Line?
options: It lies north of the equator
The line is based on wealth, not location
It asked to be placed there

questions.question: South Africa is classified by the World Bank as:
A criticism of the terms developed and developing is that they:
options: Suggest one path of development and hide historical causes such as colonialism

Which statement is correct?
options: An average income can hide large differences within a country
The North-South line follows the equator

questions.question: Why is it useful to study development at several scales in South Africa?
options: Because all areas are the same
Because national averages hide differences between provinces, cities and neighbourhoods

questions.question: A family's quality of life improves most clearly when they get:
options: Clean water, a nearby clinic and a good school
A longer walk to the river
